training_details.name: intrinclock370
training_details.facts: Human multi-tissue chronological-age methylation clock. The paper assembled 14,601 samples across 71 datasets; after QC and the study split, 9,104 were in the training set and 2,994 in validation. Original author demo distinguishes lambda.1se 370-CpG from lambda.min 380-CpG fits. The clock was designed to be relatively robust to immune-cell-composition shifts.
training_details.source_locator: Methods: dataset collection/QC and train-validation split; Results: IntrinClock development; original author Zenodo artifact RunningIntrinClock/demo.R and final_model_small.RData

training_details.name: kdmage
training_details.facts: Klemera–Doubal clinical biological-age implementation uses sex-specific NHANES III reference fits. The pinned original BioAge code filters training participants to age 30–75 and excludes pregnancy; the target is chronological age. This is a calibration/reference fit, not a single prospective cohort prediction model.
training_details.source_locator: Author functions kdm_nhanes.R and kdm_calc.R; original BioAge article DOI 10.1007/s11357-021-00480-5

training_details.name: knight
training_details.facts: Gestational-age DNAm predictor trained across six newborn cord-blood/neonatal blood-spot cohorts. Cohort-specific sample counts are tabulated by source study; shared 148-CpG model uses sites available on 27K/450K arrays. Output is gestational age at birth in weeks.
training_details.source_locator: Methods: Description of cohorts; Results: Predicting DNAm GA in neonates; Additional file 3 coefficient CSV

training_details.name: leecontrol
training_details.facts: Placental GA model trained on 963 placentas designated control; cases with recognized major placental pathology were excluded by the control cohort definition. The paper reports 546 selected CpGs; predicts GA in weeks.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Control placental clock; Table 1; Supplementary Figure S4

training_details.name: leerefinedrobust
training_details.facts: Refined RPC was refit using 733 uncomplicated term placentas (GA >36 weeks) selected from the original RPC training set, using original RPC CpGs as candidate set; paper reports 395 selected CpGs. Output is GA in weeks.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Refined robust placental clock for uncomplicated term pregnancies

training_details.name: leerobust
training_details.facts: Robust placental clock was trained using 1,102 placental samples spanning pregnancies with and without common complications; paper reports 558 selected CpGs. Output is GA in weeks.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Results: Robust placental clock; Table 1

training_details.name: lin
training_details.facts: Whole-blood 99-CpG age estimator. Age-associated CpG discovery in 27K data included a broad age range (reported selection samples span birth to 78 years); the multivariate 450K fitting step reused the adult Hannum dataset. Mortality association was a later evaluation of predicted-age residuals, not the training target.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Age-related DNAm changes in blood samples; Methods: DNAm profiles and selection of AR-CpGs; Methods: derivation of age predictors

training_details.name: linage2
training_details.facts: Clinical clock fitted to 20-year mortality in NHANES IV 1999–2000 and evaluated in the independent 2001–2002 wave. This is an adult survey population; the displayed biological-age estimate is mortality-risk-derived rather than a chronological-age training target.
training_details.source_locator: Methods: clock construction / statistics and reproducibility; Results: 20-year mortality

training_details.name: mammalian1
training_details.facts: Universal pan-mammalian chronological-age models were developed from 11,754 methylation samples across 185 mammal species (eutherian, marsupial and monotreme groups), across tissues. The three variants use distinct target transforms but all report age in years.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository UniversalPanMammalianClock

training_details.name: mammalian2
training_details.facts: Universal pan-mammalian chronological-age models were developed from 11,754 methylation samples across 185 mammal species (eutherian, marsupial and monotreme groups), across tissues. The three variants use distinct target transforms but all report age in years.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository UniversalPanMammalianClock

training_details.name: mammalian3
training_details.facts: Universal pan-mammalian chronological-age models were developed from 11,754 methylation samples across 185 mammal species (eutherian, marsupial and monotreme groups), across tissues. The three variants use distinct target transforms but all report age in years.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository UniversalPanMammalianClock

training_details.name: mammalianblood2
training_details.facts: Blood-specific variants of the universal mammalian clocks, trained on the blood subset of the Mammalian Methylation Consortium rather than the full tissue pool; chronological age is the target under the variant-specific relative-age/log-age transform.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Universal blood clocks; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository coefficient objects

training_details.name: mammalianblood3
training_details.facts: Blood-specific variants of the universal mammalian clocks, trained on the blood subset of the Mammalian Methylation Consortium rather than the full tissue pool; chronological age is the target under the variant-specific relative-age/log-age transform.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Universal blood clocks; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository coefficient objects

training_details.name: mammalianfemale
training_details.facts: Female-sex classifier developed from multi-species mammalian methylation data on the conserved mammalian array; binary sex label is the target and the packaged output is female probability.
training_details.source_locator: Methods and author supplement: sex prediction model; author source repository MammalianMethylationPredictors

training_details.name: mammalianlifespan
training_details.facts: Species-level maximum-life-span estimator fit to methylation data from about 15,000 samples covering 348 mammalian species. Target is species maximum lifespan (the package exponentiates the log-scale estimate to years), not an individual remaining lifespan.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Methods and Supplemental Tables S5–S7; original author Zenodo record https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.10783145

training_details.name: mammalianskin2
training_details.facts: Skin-specific variants trained on the skin subset of the Mammalian Methylation Consortium; chronological age is the target under variant-specific relative-age/log-age transforms.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Universal skin clocks; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository coefficient objects

training_details.name: mammalianskin3
training_details.facts: Skin-specific variants trained on the skin subset of the Mammalian Methylation Consortium; chronological age is the target under variant-specific relative-age/log-age transforms.
training_details.source_locator: Results: Universal skin clocks; Methods: Three universal pan-mammalian clocks; author repository coefficient objects

training_details.name: mayne
training_details.facts: Placental gestational-age elastic-net predictor trained on a pooled set of healthy human placenta methylation datasets; the authors report 62 selected CpGs. Early-onset preeclampsia samples were evaluated for age acceleration after model training.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Results: placental gestational-age prediction; Supplementary Table 5

training_details.name: mccartneyalcohol
training_details.facts: Ten whole-blood DNAm EpiScores were fitted in 5,087 Generation Scotland STRADL participants from EPIC data; age range is 18–99 years for the parent cohort. Phenotypes were adjusted for age, sex and 10 genetic PCs, then modeled by 10-fold LASSO; continuous scores were evaluated out of sample in 895 LBC1936 participants using 450K data. Outcomes include phenotype-specific transforms (e.g. BMI/alcohol/smoking log transforms).
training_details.source_locator: Methods: Training dataset; Phenotype preparation; LASSO regression; out-of-sample prediction cohort. Original coefficients: https://static-content.springer.com/esm/art%3A10.1186%2Fs13059-018-1514-1/MediaObjects/13059_2018_1514_MOESM1_ESM.xlsx

training_details.name: mccartneybmi
training_details.facts: Ten whole-blood DNAm EpiScores were fitted in 5,087 Generation Scotland STRADL participants from EPIC data; age range is 18–99 years for the parent cohort. Phenotypes were adjusted for age, sex and 10 genetic PCs, then modeled by 10-fold LASSO; continuous scores were evaluated out of sample in 895 LBC1936 participants using 450K data. Outcomes include phenotype-specific transforms (e.g. BMI/alcohol/smoking log transforms).

training_details.name: meer
training_details.facts: Whole-lifespan multi-tissue mouse clock trained on RRBS methylation from C57BL/6N mouse tissues (cortex, liver, heart, lung) across the lifespan; tissue-stratified train/test split and elastic-net fit. The primary article describes a 435-CpG clock and chronological age output.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Methods: Datasets; author pipeline https://github.com/gr-meer/WLMT

training_details.name: miage
training_details.facts: Mitotic-age model fitted on 4,020 tumor/adjacent-normal TCGA samples from eight cancer types and tested in 2,221 samples from five other cancer types. The original model estimates relative mitotic age from DNAm inheritance dynamics; absolute division counts are not identifiable. The packaged original parameter panel has 268 CpGs per author supplement/code.
training_details.source_locator: Abstract; Results: MiAge Calculator and unidentifiability; original author code/supplement https://github.com/anilpsori/DNAm_pipelines_and_biomarkers/tree/d84d6adfc039355d5f9c962fc5faa7d1054f56b2/biomarkers/MiAge

training_details.name: neusin
training_details.facts: Neu-Sin clocks were built from human brain methylation and use cell-type-associated age CpGs. The paper’s neuron and glia clock comparisons rely on brain cohorts; separate liver/hepatocyte clocks used 210 normal EPIC liver samples, age 18–75, for training/model selection. The listed `neusin` implementation is the brain cortex score.
training_details.source_locator: Methods: human brain DNAm datasets and liver datasets; Results: neuron and glia clocks

training_details.name: ocampoatac1
training_details.facts: Human PBMC ATAC-clock derived from 159 healthy donors aged 20–74; ATAC profiles were available for 157, with 143 passing QC. The article uses nested cross-validation and an independent external dataset. Both outputs are chronological-age estimates in years; the two packaged coefficient tables are variants of the authors’ final clock.
training_details.source_locator: Methods: donor collection, ATAC-seq and training/validation; original author code https://github.com/ATAC-clock/ATAC-clock

training_details.name: organagechronologicaladipose
training_details.facts: Chronological OrganAge elastic-net models were developed from UK Biobank plasma proteomics measured on Olink Explore 3072. The paper reports over 50,000 UK Biobank participants plus other cohorts; organ/system-specific variants and sex-stratified models are coefficient variants of the same original study. UKB consists of adults; source does not support assigning one shared age interval to every released coefficient table.

mccartney_d10_fixture.basis: Original publisher-supplied Additional file 1 workbook, not methylCIPHER/Biolearn weights. For each test row, assign beta=1 at listed CpG and beta=0 at all other model CpGs; listed coefficient is the direct linear prediction with no intercept in the supplementary table.
mccartney_d10_fixture.caveat: This synthetic fixture verifies the published coefficient equation and exposes the sigmoid effect; it is not a cohort-level performance validation. Runtime code was not changed.
